info.name: Transformation Agent - ingress and Sculpt
info.description: Use synthetic data and a dedicated test environment. Set baseUrl to https://YOUR_HOST/transformation-agent/api/v2. Ingress supplies/overwrites x-channel-name and x-service-id; no backend gateway key is required in ingress mode. Run format folders in order. Generation and feedback write database records. Feedback examples are unapproved by default. XML/ISO support needs live Sculpt verification. ISO is textual field=value, not packed ISO8583. Model status is not inference. Sculpt bearer tokens belong on the backend, not in this collection.
